# pve_storage_nfs (Resource)

Manages an NFS storage definition (`/storage`, type `nfs`). Changing `storage` or `export` forces recreation. Deletion is synchronous per the pin (no task is spawned).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Manage an NFS export as a PVE storage definition.
resource "pve_storage_nfs" "media" {
  storage = "media"
  server  = "192.168.1.10"
  export  = "/srv/export/media"

  content = ["images", "iso", "backup"]
  nodes   = "pve1,pve2"
  options = "vers=4.2,soft"
  shared  = true

  prune_backups         = "keep-last=3,keep-monthly=1"
  max_protected_backups = 5
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `export` (String) NFS export path on the server (PVE `pve-storage-path` format). The pin's update verb does not accept this field, so changing it forces recreation.
- `server` (String) Server IP or DNS name hosting the NFS export.
- `storage` (String) The storage identifier (PVE `pve-storage-id` format). Changing this value forces recreation.

### Optional

- `content` (Set of String) Allowed content types as a set (PVE `pve-storage-content-list`). NFS storages typically serve `images`, `iso`, `vztmpl`, and `backup`. PVE validates the set upstream.
- `disable` (Boolean) Flag to disable the storage.
- `max_protected_backups` (Number) Maximal number of protected backups per guest (PVE `max-protected-backups`). Use `-1` for unlimited. Must be -1 or greater.
- `nodes` (String) Comma-separated list of cluster node names the storage configuration applies to (PVE `pve-node-list`).
- `options` (String) NFS/CIFS mount options (see `man nfs`), for example `vers=4.2,soft` (PVE `pve-storage-options`).
- `prune_backups` (String) The retention options in PVE `prune-backups` format, for example `keep-last=3,keep-daily=7`.
- `shared` (Boolean) Marks the storage as a single storage with the same contents on all nodes (or all nodes listed in `nodes`). It does not make a local storage's contents accessible to other nodes.

### Read-Only

- `digest` (String) The read-only storage configuration revision (PVE `digest`).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
#!/bin/sh
# Import a PVE storage definition by its storage ID.
terraform import pve_storage_nfs.media "media"
```
